calls.statement: SELECT s.region, s.store_id, count(*) AS versions, min(valid_from), max(valid_to), min(s.store_name) FROM dim_store s GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT f.channel_code, s.store_id = 900 AS is_web, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_keys,
 sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.net_amount) AS net,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gross_mismatch,
 min(f.etl_loaded_at), max(f.etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-25' AND DATE '2024-10-05'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT w.status, count(DISTINCT w.web_order_id) AS orders, count(*) AS lines, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross,
 sum(CASE WHEN w.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_dispatch,
 min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date),
 min(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS min_disp,
 max(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS max_disp
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-25' AND DATE '2024-10-10'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT f.vat_rate, p.vat_class, f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AS after_change, count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 3,1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.region, f.gross_amount, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT l.region,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN l.gross_amount END) AS aug_gross,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN l.gross_amount END) AS sep_gross,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN l.net_amount END) AS aug_net,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN l.net_amount END) AS sep_net
FROM lines l
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', business_date) m, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, sum(returns_net) ret, sum(net_sales) ns
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.region, f.gross_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT l.region,
       SUM(l.gross_amount) FILTER (WHERE l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31') AS august_2024_gross_sales_incl_vat,
       SUM(l.gross_amount) FILTER (WHERE l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30') AS september_2024_gross_sales_incl_vat
FROM lines l
WHERE l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY l.region
ORDER BY l.region
